stories.text: ⚡ Early edge: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy went from 31% to 71% against Kirbo Crushers, led by Egbuka (17.20 pts).
🏟️ Game to watch: DET @ ARI (Sunday 4:25 PM), 10 league starters in action with 170.72 pts up for grabs.
📺 Up next, Sunday 9:30 AM (PHI VS JAX): 11 league starters, led by Kirbo Crushers vs Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy.
🗓️ Sunday's key matchup: TDsMaGee 53% vs The Mahomies. The Mahomies leads by 14.20 after TNF. Watch Daniels (20.80 pts) vs Chase (22.19 pts).
🔁 Trade that should have happened: Price and Williams for Andrews and Adams back in Week 1 would have helped both TDsMaGee and Claremont In Yo Stace!.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: Team Name leads the chopping-block odds at 35%, with Joe's Scary Team next at 20%.
🔭 Player to watch: Trevor Lawrence (PHI VS JAX). ESPN projects 19.22 pts, and Brock You Like a Hurricane is 36% against Gibb it to Me Baby.
🗓️ Another tight one Sunday: Gibb it to Me Baby 64% vs Brock You Like a Hurricane. Watch Gibbs (27.50 pts) vs Robinson (22.67 pts).
🏈 5 matchups are still up for grabs, and TDsMaGee vs The Mahomies (TDsMaGee 53%) is the tightest.
💸 Won by a whisker in the guillotine league: In My Fantasy Era landed James Cook III (RB) for $201, just $1 more than Moose Knucklers and Joe's Scary Team bid.
📈 TRENDING: Roschon Johnson (RB, CHI) is one of the most-added players in fantasy over the past 24 hours. Nobody here has him.
🤔 What could have been: Hampton and Boston for Nabers and Burrow back in Week 1 would have helped both Kyle Tucker and Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy.
📈 49er Faith-Fool was down to 16% against The Mahomies — and won.
